translations.description_clean:
Recent Changes
Compatibility update for 1.9.

Description
A small mod that adds ticking warscore to the following wargoals:

* Cede Planet
* Liberate Planet
* Cleanse Planet
* Dismantle Habitat
* Make Tributary
* Make Protectorate
* Vassalize
* Artificial Intelligence Ban
* Stop Atrocities
* Humiliate
* Dismantle Frontier Outpost
* Total Victory

For the wargoals that operate on planets, you will gain 0.5 warscore a month as long as you occupy the planet or habitat in question. Make Tributary, Make Protectorate, and Vassalize will give 1 warscore a month once all the planets in the target empire have been occupied. AI Ban, Stop Atrocities, Humiliate, Dismantle Frontier Outpost, and Total Victory will give 1 warscore a month if you occupy the target empire's capital world. Multiple ticking wargoals will stack and will apply to both the attacker and the defender as long as the goals are met.

This also includes a slight balance change in that it's no longer more expensive to demand planets from an empire's Federation allies or their vassals. 

This mod modifies the following files

00_misc_war_demands.txt
00_planetary_war_demands.txt
00_station_war_demands.txt
00_subject_war_demands.txt
00_special_war_demands.txt
translations.title_zh_current: 随时间累积的战争分数（Ticking Warscore）
translations.summary_zh_current: 为割让星球、解放、清洗、附庸化、羞辱、总胜利等战争目标添加随时间累积的战争分数，使战争进展更合理。
translations.description_zh_current: 本 MOD 为以下战争目标添加随时间累积的战争分数（Ticking Warscore）：割让星球、解放星球、清洗星球、拆除居住站、设为朝贡国、设为保护国、附庸化、AI 禁令、停止暴行、羞辱、拆除前哨站、总胜利。机制：针对行星的战争目标，只要占领目标星球/居住站，每月获得 0.5 战争分数；设为朝贡/保护国/附庸化在占领目标帝国全部行星后每月 +1；AI 禁令、停止暴行、羞辱、拆除前哨站、总胜利在占领目标帝国首都后每月 +1。多个累积战争分数可叠加，对攻守双方都生效（满足条件即可）。另附带平衡调整：从联邦盟友或附庸处索要行星不再更贵。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 占领目标星球或首都即可让战争分数随时间累积，战争不再只靠一次性胜利得分。适合喜欢真实战争节奏的玩家。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 1.8 万、收藏 751。这是一款战争分数小模组，作者自述为割让行星、解放行星、清洗行星、附庸化、羞辱等多类战争目标加入随时间累积的战争分数机制，占领对应目标或首都即可按月累积，多个目标可叠加。作者还调整了向联邦盟友或附庸索取行星的成本。本模组修改若干战争需求文件。为 1.9 版本。作者未提供更多评价信息。
translations.features_zh_current: ["12 类战争目标累积战争分数", "占领行星/首都驱动", "多目标可叠加", "附带平衡调整"]

For Stellaris: 4.3.*

Adds many new Planetary Wonders, with custom icons, images and events.
Wonders are buildings that take up a district slot, a lot of resources and time, but provide many jobs and bonuses.
Only one allowed per planet, more can be unlocked by the new Ascension Perk.
Only Void Dwellers (or with Voidborne) can build them on Habitats.
Every Wonder is planet-unique, and some are empire-unique.

Japanese translation - "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2352049755] Planetary Wonders" by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198097877684]FebHare
If you enjoy my work you can [url=https://ko-fi.com/namfoodle]buy me a coffee at Ko-Fi!
Features
Wonders
Space Elevator
- Adds Clerks and Merchants (or Logistics Drones) and many different bonuses.

Research Wonders: Each is Empire Unique. Complete Special Event Chains to upgrade them.
- Particle Supercollider -> Interdimensional Collider;
- Domed City -> Psionic Observatory;
- Abyssal Test Crater -> Metal Vivarium;

Astronomical Model Bureau (Empire Unique)
- Bureaucrats, Administrators and more administration bonuses.
- Complete the event chain to upgrade to Aligned Galactic Model.

Enigma Engine (For Machine Empires, requires Synthetic Dawn)
- Empire Unique and only on Machine Worlds.
- Adds Enigma Operators, that produce research and unity.
- Unlocks new mysterious Enigma Technology.

Solipsist Debate Hall (For Hive Minds, requires Utopia)
- Empire Unique and only on Hive Worlds.
- Adds a variety of jobs per pop.
- Allows for Debates Events where I pretend to understand philosophy the empire gains bonuses as the gestalt debates with itself or plays chess.

Guardian Angel
- Adds Soldiers and Enforcers.
- Creates a Flying Fortress army to defend the planet.
- Special features for times of peace.
- Upgrades to Stellar Sentinel.

Resource Wonders:
- Erebus Project -> Erebus Fracking Plant
- Helios Tower -> Helios Translucer Obelisk
- Demetrius Cornucopia -> Demetrius Chemical Garden

- Each adds Miners, Technicians and Farmers respectively and boosts those jobs.
- Each upgrade is Empire Unique and adds jobs that produce rare resources.

Mantle Crucible
- Adds Metallurgists and Artisans.
- Decreases habitability, increases alloy and consumer goods production.
- Can upgrade to Titan Forge which is Empire Unique, provides only Metallurgists and unlocks the War Titan army.
- OR can upgrade to Industrial Hearth which is Empire Unique, provides new Poly-Artisan jobs (that produce consumer goods and unity) and unlocks special technologies.

Pavilion of Wonders
- Adds Entertainers and Culture Workers.
- Unlocks decision to host art exhibitions across the empire (even more with the Mega Art Installation Megastructure).
- Can upgrade to Fair of Worlds which is Empire Unique and only for Xenophiles, improves the exhibitions and unlocks a campaign.
- OR can upgrade to Museum of the Grotesque which is Empire Unique and only for Xenophobes, improves the exhibitions and unlocks a campaign.

Holy Reliquary (Spiritualists only)
- Adds Priests (and a Relic Keeper when all artifacts are sanctified).
- Unlocks an edict and a decision to access the Reliquary, a new menu to sanctify 7 artifacts corresponding to each (base) tradition.
- Each Artifact has unique modifiers that can be changed at any time.
- Sanctify artifacts by spending Unity, change modifiers by spending Influence.

The Grand Archive (Materialists only)
- Adds Grand-Archivists (and a Master Archivist when all collections are assembled).
- Unlocks an edict and a decision to access the Archive, a new menu to assemble 9 collections corresponding to each research field.
- Each Collection adds a Planetary Deposit that boosts research and unlocks unique techs.
- Assemble collections by spending Unity and completing special projects, unlock their techs by spending Influence.

Transplanetary Logistics Network (Egalitarian only)
- Unlocks decision to improve infrastructure (Planetary Features).
- There are 4 types of infrastructure and each has 4 levels.
- The last level requires a specific Wonder in that planet (like Guardian Angel for Crisis Responders).

Forbidden City (Authoritarian only)
- Unlocks decision to improve infrastructure (Planetary Features).
- There are 3 types of infrastructure and each has 4 levels, but one is only available on the capital.
- Each ethic has its own infrastructure too.

Festival Plaza (Pacifist only)
- Unlocks decisions to make Peace Festivals.
- Each Peace Festival increases the rank of a Peace Stability country modifier.
- All modifiers/festivals are suspended during wars.

Martial Avenue (Militarist only)
- Unlocks decisions to make Martial Parades.
- Each Martial Parades increases the rank of a War Drive country modifier.
- War Drive can cause debuffs if too high, but turns into War Lust (no debuffs) during wars.

Department of Xenoeconomics (Megacorps only)
- Increases trade value and branch office value.
- Unlocks unique Branch Office Buildings that exploit other countries ethics in the name of profit.
- New Branch Office Buildings are planet-unique and restricted to 1 on each foreign empire.

Panopticon
- For Penal Colonies (or Police State empires).
- Unlocks the Panspectron edict.

Blossoming Preserve
- For Gaia and Hive Wolds.
- Unlocks the Harmonious Blossom edict.

Nostalgia Paradise
- For Resort Worlds and Rogue Servitors.
- Choose a theme for the resort.

Unhallowed Necropolis
- For Tomb/Relic Wolds and Necro empires.
- Allows the designation of Mausoleum Worlds.

Feasting Grounds
- For Devouring Swarm/Terravore empires.
- Allows a decision to start banquets, that when completed give bonuses.

Living Spire (Unlocked by AP - for Regular Empires)
- Has 4 stages that gives bonuses to housing, growth and amenities.
- Adopts a designation when concluded.

Conduit of Unity (Unlocked by AP - for Gestalts Empires)
- Has 2 stages and unlocks Decision to build Planetary Deposits.
- Planetary Deposits represent Integrated Infras

Corrects combat behaviors to something more realistic.
Please test, review, and let me know how it works. I desperately need detailed feedback.

I do not actually play Stellaris, I only make mods. That is how I have fun. Since I do not actually play, I have no idea what would best for you. Please give me written feedback.

Compatibility
This addon has been endorsed by a frighteningly large number of the top addon authors on the workshop, including NSC, Realistic Ships, ASBM, and TFW's BOSP.

This mod is 100% compatible with all other mods. Not just the ones mentioned above.

It's a good companion mod to ASBM. This mod will fix any ship that does NOT use ASBMs behaviors. That includes the AI, and all ingame non-standard empires and ships. When you equip the "Non-AI" computer on your ships, it overrides this mod.

What's going on?
Some time ago I spent some effort [url=http://www.stellariswiki.com/Ship_modding]documenting the technical details of Stellaris' ship behavior.

It was during this endeavour that I realised whoever implemented the ship behavior changes for Stellaris 1.3 and later can not possibly be the same person who created the system initially. And whoever created it initially has not documented it for the new developers at Paradox.

Short and sweet; it's completely broken.

This mod represents (what I've concluded is) the least intrusive, most cross-mod compatible way to fix it.

[*]It is compatible with all addons.
[*]It fixes ship behaviors across any installed addon that adds ship types
[*]It has no user-facing interface or ingame representation, but works completely behind the scenes.


The mod is experimental, in the sense that I don't actually play the game that much. I merely make addons. As such, there's a limited set of scenarios I can test reliably.

The addon solves two major issues.

1. Ship targeting
Vanilla ships that equip Torpedoes, XL weapons, and some few others, will actually never attack non-vanilla (addon/mod) ships on purpose until all vanilla ships are dead.

There are obviously many scenarios where they will fire on non-vanilla ships, but at no point in a battle - while vanilla ships are alive - will these be their main target.

(Some addons "fix" this by overwriting the vanilla weapon files to add in their ship types as explicit targets. That sounds like a sustainable solution, right? I am not blaming them, it's obviously the solution Paradox intended - it's the solution they use themselves, after all. One issue with this is that only one installed mod can overwrite a vanilla file at a time. But that's not the only issue.)

Possibly the most obvious example of this is if you take a fleet of vanilla ships + Dreadnought from Realistic Ships to fight the Stellarite Devourer. It will simply never fire at the Dreads until the vanilla ships are dead. This is, as far as I have found, the best test scenario for this behavior. But it is - in fact - present in all fleet battles.

Another obvious example of completely broken behavior is the large Pirate Galleon that sometimes spawns. It will relentlessly kill your ships reliably in size order, from small to large. This is due to another issue than the one described above, but I've fixed this as well.

2. Movement fluidity
When vanilla fleets engage eachother, their movement is horrible and jagged. This can be fixed slightly by increasing formation scale and other tricks that NSC, ISB: Graphics, and other addons do. This mod makes it even smoother.

From limited testing it seems I can't make it smoother than what the addon currently does without overwriting more vanilla files that are commonly touched by other addons. But frankly this is not the main priority of the mod.


Behavior adjustments
Specifically, regarding combat targeting, here's the priorities this mod applies;

[*]Corvettes will charge into combat, focus any target they find, and when they see a large ship with all shields depleted, they charge and kill it
[*]Destroyers try to stay in the middle of the battle field, picking off low health targets
[*]Cruisers unleash their firepower on any ship not focused by Corvettes or Destroyers, mid-range, and try to help other ships finish off their targets
[*]Battleships stay in the back (but not as far back as vanilla), and fire on targets that no other ship is firing on. This results in them most of the time focusing the targets furthest away

As a player, what's worth knowing is that most addons (NSC, Realships, etc) that add ships already map (assign) their ships to one of these four behaviors. And if they do have their own behavior defined, which is exceptionally rare, this addon will not interfere with them at all.

Specifically, what did I do?
The problem is mostly to do with something Paradox calls component_target_weight_mult. Whenever a weapon (yes, all weapons pick their own targets) wants to pick a new target, it runs through a list of score bonuses and penalties. This list is extremely limited, and hard to work with. But in 1.3, Paradox added some new behavior (target_weight) to the XL and Torpedo slots that completely overrides this behavior, using component_target_weight_mult.

This addon prevents that entirely. Overriding their explicit-case override.
If you're an addon author, it means this mod makes ships ignore target_weights you set in your weapon components.

I could go on, but that seems like enough for now. Read the wiki, and my Aggro! computer addon code if you want to know more. I also wrote an article on the PDX forums that I have linked from my Aggro! workshop description.

Please let me know if you have any comments, questions, or suggestions.

Replaced files
The mod replaces the following game files:
common/ship_behaviors/00_strike_craft.txt
common/ship_behaviors/standard_ship_behaviors.txt

If some other mod overwrites these files before us (the first letter in their mod preceeds "A", for example "!" and "(")

This is a performance mod that mostly prevents the AI from causing the game to lag due to some of its actions, among other things. The mod gets the AI under control without affecting the gameplay of players and almost not affecting (as much as possible) the AI's gameplay.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif⠀[url=https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=3G6BLVZBHM4YS]https://i.imgur.com/1BWfuZR.png
What the mod does to effectively boost performance:

[*]Disable AI Hyper Relays: Stops the AI from constructing Hyper Relays as they degrade performance especially with their required amount (optional).

[*]Restrict AI Gateways: Stops the AI from constructing Gateways more than twice every 100 years to prevent the AI from building them too quickly, unnecessarily (optional and configurable).

[*]Disable AI Deep Space Citadels: stops the AI from building multiple Deep Space Citadels in every system as that can make navigating fleets in galaxy view annoying and blocking (optional).

[*]Modifier Updating Optimisation: Reduces the burden of updating modifiers by decreasing their update frequency to 3 times per month (optional).

[*]Disable AI Xeno-Compatibility: Stops the AI from getting Xeno-Compatibility ascension perk to prevent unnecessary hybrid species (optional).

[*]Disable AI Omnicodex Relic: Stops the AI from getting the Omnicodex Relic to prevent unnecessary hybrid species (optional and configurable).

[*]Restrict AI Ringworlds: Stops the AI from constructing ringworlds by introducing a limit of 3 ringworlds per AI (optional and configurable).

[*]Restrict AI Habitats: Stops the AI from constructing habitats by introducing a limit of 7 habitats per AI (optional and configurable).

[*]Restrict AI Sub-species: It limits the AI from creating large number of sub-species, limiting it to 2.

[*]Improve AI unemployment: Fills AI job vacancies faster and reduces unemployment by resettling the unemployed pops to planets with open jobs to prevent increased checking (optional).

[*]Restrict AI Corvettes/Frigates: Stops the AI from building corvettes, frigates, destroyers, and cruiser by putting a cap on corvettes and frigates to 60, destroyers to 30, and cruisers to 15 per fleet. Once the AI reaches the cap(s), a corvette is replaced with a frigate, and 2 frigates are replaced with a destroyer, and 2 destroyers are replaced with a cruiser, and 2 cruisers are replaced with a battleship. This should make AI fleets less corvette heavy and stronger (the 2 for 1 trade-off works out economically). This also allies to bio-ships and only occurs when possible e.g., when the AI has destroyer technology and cruiser technology for balance reasons (optional and configurable).

[*]Prevent AI micro-marketing: Prevents the AI from continuously market micro selling and buying small amounts when resource capacity is full.

[*]Restrict AI Eternal Vigilance: Prevents the AI from picking the full and half spending policy options from the Eternal Vigilance ascension perk (optional).

[*]Restrict AI Science/Construction Ships: Stops the AI from building science and construction ships by putting a cap of 6 (by default). Once the AI reaches the cap(s), it will not be able to build anymore which will reduce fleet pathing related performance hits if the ships are excessively built (optional and configurable).

[*]Improve AI fleet count: Prevents the AI from having multiple partly filled fleets and merges them when possible while not at war. This should also provide a relatively good performance boost (optional).

[*]Enable some AI opt on players: As a preference, you can enable some of the AI optimisations to be also applied on players for potential balance and further performance gains. These currently include (if not disabled); just 'Restrict AI Eternal Vigilance' (optional).

Most of the features listed above can be disabled or configured at game start if desired or through an edict during a game; using a custom UI for better accessibility.

Further tuning that can be done manually if needed:
- Lower habitable planets.
- Lower guaranteed planets.
- Disable Logistics Ship Cost (Can give more performance potentially but it's an unreliable option at the moment).

Once the AI reaches the cap(s), it will not be able to build anymore which will reduce fleet pathing related performance hits if the ships are excessively built (optional and configurable).

translations.description_zh_current: 本 MOD 是性能优化 MOD，主要防止 AI 的某些行为导致游戏卡顿，在不影响玩家玩法、尽量少影响 AI 表现的前提下控制 AI。具体手段（均可选/可配置）：禁用 AI 建造超空间中继站（Hyper Relays）；限制 AI 建造星门（每 100 年不超过 2 个）；禁用 AI 在每个星系建造多个深空堡垒；将修正更新频率降低为每月 3 次；禁用 AI 获取异种兼容（Xeno-Compatibility）飞升防止杂交物种泛滥；禁用 AI 获取 Omnicodex 圣物；限制 AI 建造环世界等。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 直接启用即可获得性能提升，所有限制项都可在 MOD 设置中开关或调整阈值，玩家自身不受限制。适合后期大银河、AI 数量多导致卡顿的存档。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 37158、收藏 3106。本模组为性能优化类补丁，主要防止 AI 的某些行为导致游戏卡顿，在不影响玩家游玩、并尽量不影响 AI 游玩的前提下约束 AI。功能均为可选并可配置：禁用 AI 建造超空间中继器、限制 AI 星门建造频率、禁用 AI 深空堡垒、降低修正器更新频率、禁用 AI 获取异种兼容飞升、禁用 AI 获取全能法典遗物、限制 AI 环世界与栖息地数量、限制 AI 亚种数量、改善 AI 失业处理等。作者说明个别功能（如亚种限制）为固定限制。
translations.features_zh_current: ["禁用 AI 超空间中继站", "限制 AI 星门建造频率", "禁用 AI 深空堡垒堆建", "降低修正更新频率", "禁用 AI 异种兼容与 Omnicodex"]

The Zenith of Fallen Empires 3.0 is now [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2044599287]LIVE

The Zenith of Fallen Empires 2.0 will continue to work with Game Updates 2.3-2.5, while 3.0 will be supported beyond the 2.6 Federations update.



Several millennia ago, the galaxy had glimpsed apocalypse when Ascended Empires waged war and brought death to countless civilizations. Convinced of the righteousness of this Great Crusade, each Ascended Empire pushed the limits of science, fielding massive fleets armed with new superweapons at every turn, each more dangerous than the last. Great battles were fought with many more planets caught in the crossfire, leaving thousands of tomb worlds echoing through the void of space. Today, the Titan guns lay silent, their technology not yet reimagined by the primitives who had survived the Great Crusade. Few empires would reach the pinnacle of civilization, and the lessons of the Great Crusade showed that even the mightiest can fall. For all their achievements, now the Fallen Empires are shadows of their former selves, crippled by internal fighting and general apathy. Oh they have seen war like the primitives wouldn’t believe, and that is why they must stand as eternal reminders for all younger races the value of galactic peace.


The Zenith of Fallen Empires retraces the steps of the fallen, their rise to the pinnacle of civilization and military might. The mod imagines that they were once Ascended Empires wielding massive power, all pursuing their own vision for the galaxy. However, with great power, comes great responsibility, and possibly consequence. In a dangerous era where Ascended Empires carve out their own sphere of influence, lesser empires must align themselves or face annihilation. All-out war between the Ascended Empires would return the galaxy back to the inferno it once was many millennia ago during the Great Crusade. Originally designed as a full experience of this journey in a previous iteration, The Zenith of Fallen Empires 2.0 will be delivered with several add-on component mods, allowing players the full freedom to customise their game based on the features they need to tell an epic story of their empire’s rise – and fall.


The Zenith of Fallen Empires 2.0:



[*]Become an Ascended Empire*

[*]Escorts, Battlecruisers, Fallen Titans, and more

[*]Fallen Empire Buildings

What comes next? Check [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1317022177/1694914735996548907]this thread to stay up to date.

If you really enjoy the mod and would like to give something back to the mod creator, check out my [url=https://www.patreon.com/kolyn]Patreon to see how you could help, or visit [url=https://www.paypal.me/ThomasYip]Paypal. Alternatively, you can help answer newb questions in the comment section or in the forum below. This mod isn’t free for me to make, and if you help me, I can keep helping you!

Societal Evolution requires an empire to cater for its citizens. Unbeknownst to these citizens, each building in turn shapes their society, gradually moving them towards the path of fanaticism.

translations.title_zh_current: 质量效应原声（Mass Effect Soundtrack）
translations.summary_zh_current: 将《质量效应》三部曲原声音乐加入群星的音乐 MOD，兼容铁人与成就，另有氛围版与动作版两个变体。
translations.description_zh_current: 本 MOD 将《质量效应》1-3 代的原声音乐加入群星游戏。兼容性：与其他 MOD 兼容，不替换原版原声，兼容铁人与成就模式，支持版本 3.6+ 且应兼容后续版本。曲目涵盖 ME1 的《The Citadel》《Vigil》《Sovereign's Theme》，ME2 的《Suicide Mission》《The Illusive Man》，ME3 的《Leaving Earth》《An End Once and for All》等经典曲目。另有 Atmosphere（氛围精简版，主打行星氛围曲）与 Action pack（动作包，收录最燃战斗曲）两个变体 MOD。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 订阅后在游戏音乐播放列表中即可听到质量效应原声。三个版本任选：完整版（含全部曲目）、氛围版（精简低调试听感）、动作包（战斗燃曲）。兼容成就与铁人。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 2.46 万、收藏 2720。这是将《质量效应》1-3 代原声音乐加入群星的模组，并另提供氛围精简版与动作包两个变体。
